intro: Banner of the Fallen tells the grim story of Mountaineer Ylva, a brave dwarf who ventured into trogg territory to track down missing comrades. After falling in battle and having her Ironforge standard trampled, raising the banner once more draws out her killer to face justice.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The fallen mountaineer bears a standard of Ironforge. Perhaps she was scouting, or making a doomed charge. Either way, the standard has been cast down and trampled. The mountaineer was hit on the head so hard that her helm was knocked off and she was killed outright by a trogg, likely with a spiked club.
The trogg that killed her is probably still nearby, and likely remembers the banner. Raising the banner of Ironforge once more may call it out.

clips.title: Progress
paras: That banner looks like it's been in a war!

clips.title: Completion
paras: You found Ylva's body? Ah, the poor woman. She said she was going to show the troggs that Ironforge would never fall to their kind. She went looking for a few mountaineers who never returned from a patrol through trogg country. She was always too independent-minded to be cautious. Now we know what happened.
I'll take the banner back and make sure it's cleaned up and displayed. You should take her weapon. May it serve you well against the troggs.
